title: Claude on Google Cloud’s Vertex AI: FedRAMP High and IL2 Authorized
translatedTitle: Google Cloud Vertex AI 上的 Claude：获得 FedRAMP High 与 IL2 授权
subtitle: Claude is now authorized for FedRAMP High and IL2 workloads on Google Cloud's Vertex AI, enabling federal agencies and defense organizations to use our models while meeting strict compliance requirements.
